survey_records.wording: Favoring or opposing a ban on handgun sales.
survey_records.wording_note: Paraphrased summary. Nationwide telephone survey of 1,502 adults; asked all respondents. PDF page 5 documents methodology; page 7 (printed page 6) gives Q27. Sales are distinct from possession.
survey_records.weight: Published national topline; no respondent-level recalculation.
survey_records.denominator: All 1,502 adults, including don’t know/refused responses. Original percentages retained.
survey_records.orientation: Favor means favoring the sales ban; oppose means opposing it.

survey_records.source_locator: Opening findings and Survey Methods; question and full table corroborated by PollingReport, USA Today/Gallup February 8–10, 2008 entry.
survey_records.wording: Whether the Second Amendment protects Americans’ gun ownership generally or only ownership by state militia members.
survey_records.wording_note: Paraphrased summary. The alternative mentions National Guard units. Gallup’s original report verifies 73%/20%, dates and national adult base. Its chart was inaccessible; PollingReport supplies question wording and the published 7% unsure category (https://www.pollingreport.com/guns3.htm). No residual was inferred. This asks about constitutional interpretation, not approval of Heller or unrestricted gun ownership.
survey_records.weight: Published national telephone topline; no respondent-level recalculation.
survey_records.denominator: All 1,016 national adults aged 18 and older, including unsure responses. Published percentages retained.
survey_records.orientation: The individual-right answer agrees with the narrow individual-versus-militia distinction; it does not measure support for all consequences of the ruling.
